consumer: A dialogue/condition check (conditional_t::set_has_item) asking the yes/no question 'does this character personally hold the detonator?', which the engine EVALUATES as a computed predicate over the character actor.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded weapon + worn items + personal inventory), NOT items reachable in a nearby crate
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t::set_has_item — its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), an on-person possession predicate scoped to the character actor; src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::visit_items confirms that scope is wielded+worn+inv only.
divergence: A detonator sitting in an adjacent crate that is within the player's crafting reach but is NOT on the player's body: the correct on-person check returns false, while the wrong-reach authority (mission.cpp MGOAL_FIND_ITEM over u.crafting_inventory()) returns true.
